decisions.statement: A service nothing has looked at states this neither way.
The verdict holds one look's finding rather than the service's state now.
A look writes the verdict only where the look's finding differs from the verdict written.
How long ago the verdict was written says nothing.
A value cleared away is written again by the next look.
A service no longer looked at keeps the verdict the last look reaching that service left.

definition: whether a service was running as it should when last looked at
